LESSON: INTERACTIVE SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: FRENCH
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.9: Interactive Speaking

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Interactive Speaking. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you communicate without talking?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. respond to questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement
2. use vocabulary and expressions appropriately to probe and engage in oral interactions
3. use non-verbal communication cues to enhance communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: INTERACTIVE SPEAKING
This lesson teaches Interactive Speaking for Grade 7 FRENCH.

STUDY STEPS
1. respond to questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use vocabulary and expressions appropriately to probe and engage in oral interactions
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. use non-verbal communication cues to enhance communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Interactive Speaking using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Interactive Speaking above.
2. Explain Interactive Speaking to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Interactive Speaking.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Interactive Speaking with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Interactive Speaking important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you communicate without talking?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. respond to questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement
2. use vocabulary and expressions appropriately to probe and engage in oral interactions
3. use non-verbal communication cues to enhance communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
